name: Negotiation Preparation
description: Prepare for a negotiation using interests, alternatives, evidence, issue packages, concessions, boundaries, questions, and post-session decision discipline.

tasks.name: Define objectives and authority
tasks.objective: Clarify desired outcomes, must-haves, preferences, authority limits, deadlines, stakeholders, relationship considerations, legal/ethical constraints, and approval requirements.

tasks.name: Develop BATNA and reservation boundaries
tasks.objective: Identify realistic alternatives if no agreement occurs, estimate their costs/timing/risks, define reservation points, and separate true constraints from habitual preferences.

tasks.name: Map counterpart interests and evidence
tasks.objective: Research likely interests, constraints, incentives, alternatives, decision process, precedents, market benchmarks, facts in dispute, and assumptions requiring questions rather than mind-reading.

tasks.name: Design issue packages and trades
tasks.objective: List negotiable issues, priorities, objective criteria, opening proposals, conditional trades, concession sequence, dependencies, non-monetary value, and language for protecting key boundaries.

tasks.name: Rehearse scenarios
tasks.objective: Practice likely objections, information requests, pressure tactics, silence, impasse, escalation, multi-issue trades, and internal caucus points. Prepare questions and evidence, not scripted domination.

tasks.name: Capture agreement and next steps
tasks.objective: After the session, record agreed terms, unresolved items, conditional language, owners, deadlines, approvals, documents to revise, and discrepancies between notes before treating anything as final.
